_note: Where uploaded files are filed in the project's own Google Drive (the operations.academia account).
One entry per JOB MARKET YEAR (see marketYear() in _scraper/jobs-model.mjs:
a market year runs 1 July to 30 June and is numbered by the year it ends).
The ids are the folders inside 'Current JM' — open each in Drive and copy
the part of the URL after /folders/.
WHEN THE MARKET ROLLS (1 July): you archive 'Current JM' into
'Past JM data/<year> JM' and its folders get NEW ids. Add the new year's
entry here. Nothing falls back to last year's folder on purpose — an
upload for a season with no entry is REFUSED rather than filed somewhere
wrong, because a CV quietly landing in the previous season's folder is
invisible until someone goes looking for it.

RESOURCE KEYS: these folders predate September 2021, so Drive issues them a resourcekey (the ?resourcekey= part of the URL). It is only required when access comes from a LINK rather than from ownership — our token is the owner's, so it should not be needed. It is stored anyway and sent as the X-Goog-Drive-Resource-Keys header, because doing so costs nothing and the failure it prevents is an opaque 404.
